nodes.label: Parallel vs Serialized Work Decomposition
nodes.rationale: Only tasks with independent write sets and decisions may run in parallel. Shared schema/contract decisions, migrations, provider-default changes, same-file edits, adapters depending on unfinished producers, and final merge/test/QA/Git/deploy must be serialized. With four agent slots, one integrator plus at most three workers, because parallelism beyond the available independent work only increases conflicts.

nodes.label: Parallel Worker Brief Template
nodes.rationale: Every worker prompt must state objective, owner and product step, read-only vs writable scope, allowed and forbidden files, live contracts, expected evidence, validation commands and handoff format. Workers are never told to run source hooks, handle credentials, auto-commit, push, deploy, delete branches, or persist session transcripts.

nodes.label: Integrator Duties
nodes.rationale: The integrator inspects each worker's evidence rather than accepting a success claim, resolves overlapping assumptions, re-reads changed shared contracts, runs producer and consumer tests together, runs final repository gates in the shared worktree, and reports adopted/rejected/unresolved findings. Parallel authorization never waives sandbox, approval, owner, contract, dirty-tree or destructive-action rules.
